reviews.review: Severely lacking in content... Its clear Valve attempted something just for the community to pick up the scraps
this game is fun but i dont understand why its dead.. still fun tho - 10/10
This is what Aliens Fireteam should have played like, challenging maps and proper enemy AI.

Alien Swarm is my third most played game after Team Fortress 2 and RUNNING WITH RIFLES. I’m slowly approaching 1000 hours week by week and if Valve had bothered to support Alien Swarm more I’m fairly confident I would have easily have a playtime measured in thousands of hours.

Valve considered Alien Swarm an experimental tech demo more than an actual release, and despite that it is still one of the most fun top-down shooters I’ve played. The movement is extremely satisfying, the gun play is reasonably more in-depth than just holding left click, and every map in the [b]single[/b] official campaign has Valve’s signature level of polish.

Alien Swarm is similar to Left 4 Dead but accommodates both arcade-style and more serious play within the exact same gameplay loop. The official campaign is extremely well balanced in terms of encounters, enemy variety, ammo scarcity, and chokepoints, and that careful balance lets you play with from 2 players to 4 from normal right up to brutal.

The biggest issue Alien Swarm has is the campaign which is 2 hours long at best. Alien Swarm predates the Steam Workshop so installing additional community campaigns [i](many of which are of questionable quality)[/i] must be done in the old way by copying over VPK files. Alien Swarm can’t download custom content, which blocks many players from even joining custom campaigns in the first place.

Many people only play this game because of the TF2 tie-in and it’s a great shame many simply uninstall it the moment they unlock Hat Trick or get all of the achievements. It’s a great, timeless game that can be enjoyed on effectively any PC thanks to good optimisation.

If you’re interested in learning more about Alien Swarm, take a look at my Steam guide [url= https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666302313]The IAF Bible[/url].
